objective: Prove, on the n x n square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced contacts and law (12,12): influence between contacts is governed by L = x + 1/x + y + 1/y = (x + y)(1 + 1/xy) over GF(2); a contact needs a ring exactly when some power of L (with the contact-type shifts) reaches one of the ring's contacts, first at lag g k + 1 and then at infinitely many, eventually periodic lags; for odd n every contact needs every ring; for even n no contact ever needs the ring antipodal to it, and for n a power of two the feedback is finite; cutting the contacts on the boundary of any set of rings separates it from the rest (native separation on odd tori), while one ring of cuts round the torus does not separate and two do.
status: Proved 2026-11-08 (by hand; finite claims checked exactly): on the n x n square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12,12) contacts, composition is the powers of L = x + 1/x + y + 1/y = (x + y)(1 + 1/xy) over GF(2); a contact needs a ring exactly when an odd number of contact-graph walks of some length k lead from one of its contacts, first at lag g k + 1 and then at infinitely many, eventually periodic lags; on odd tori every contact needs every ring; on even tori no contact ever needs the ring antipodal to it, and for n a power of two the feedback is finite; cutting the boundary of any set of rings separates it (native separation on odd tori), one ring of cuts round the torus does not separate, two do.
title: Odd tori compose everywhere, even tori never reach the antipode; rings of cuts separate when they bound
